title: Lectures on Preaching
author: Phillips Brooks
rights: Public domain (published 1877; author d. 1893). Scan and OCR: Internet Archive.
citation: Brooks, Phillips. Lectures on Preaching, Delivered before the Divinity School of Yale College. New York: E. P. Dutton, 1877. Public domain; Internet Archive scan.
editorialMarkers: “Preaching is the bringing of truth through personality” — eight Yale lectures on the preacher rather than the outline. Episcopalian, Boston, 1877; read for the calling, not the method.
method: Internet Archive OCR text per volume; treatises open at a capitalised title block (“A TREATISE …”, “THE nth BOOK OF THE TREATISE …”); paragraphs by blank lines; page numbers, lone running heads and volume signatures dropped; hyphenation joined; the index and catalogue matter cut. The scan’s own damage is repaired: headings whose letters the scanner misread, the translator’s footnotes standing as paragraphs of the work, the publisher’s sales catalogue, and words split by the gutter. A letter is corrected only where the printed word is not in doubt — a token no lexicon knows with exactly one candidate; anything ambiguous is left as scanned.
